THE LEARNING PATH

Where do we start? What comes next?

Twenty-six classes are ready now, from birth to age five, in one calm sequence. Each class takes two to five playful minutes and is led by you. Age ranges are a guide, not a test — start where your child is and follow their cues.

Growing upAges 3–12

Classrooms for older children

Beyond the early years, the school opens into hands-on classrooms: Art Studio, Science Lab, Nature Club, Maths Room, Story Corner and Build & Tinker, plus all activities by age.

+
PreschoolAge 3 magic games

The magic games — a separate shelf for playful practice

Play: Look & Draw — Magic Shapes (Class 3) · Animal Sound Safari (Class 6)

Two gentle interactive games with no scores, no timers and no sign-up — each one is wired to its Age 3 class and lives on its own shelf, outside the class sequence.

Age ranges are a guide, not a test. Children learn at their own pace. Explore in any order that suits your family, and stop whenever your child has had enough.
